eligibility.evidence: Sections 3.1, 3.3, 4: cosine similarity of hidden-layer embeddings of number tokens from BERT, RoBERTa, XLNet, GPT-2, T5, BART, fitted to distance/size/ratio functions; no prompts or generated responses. Human reaction times enter only through a linking hypothesis. Representation analysis without behavioural task outcome (E4); mostly encoder models (E1).

A.title: Human Behavioral Benchmarking: Numeric Magnitude Comparison Effects in Large Language Models

G.notes: Embedding-similarity probing of six small encoder/decoder models (Table 1), no behavioural responses; a referee would ask whether the linking hypothesis (cosine similarity as reaction time) makes this a behavioural study. Borderline on E1/E4 only.
